title: 正弦位置编码数值输出
code:
import numpy as np
def positional_encoding(seq_len, d_model):
    pe = np.zeros((seq_len, d_model))
    pos = np.arange(seq_len)[:, None]
    i = np.arange(d_model)[None, :]
    div = 1.0/(10000.0**(2*(i//2)/d_model))
    pe[:, 0::2] = np.sin(pos * div[:, 0::2])
    pe[:, 1::2] = np.cos(pos * div[:, 1::2])
    return pe
pe = positional_encoding(5, 8)
print("位置编码(5 位置, 8 维):")
for p in range(5):
    print(f"  pos{p}: " + " ".join(f"{v:+.3f}" for v in pe[p]))
print("pos0 与 pos1 的 L2 距离(应>0, 位置可区分):", round(float(np.linalg.norm(pe[0]-pe[1])),4))
print("每个位置编码的 L2 范数(应一致≈sqrt(维度/2*2)):", round(float(np.linalg.norm(pe[0])),4))
